name: jobs_board_scan
prompt:
The script output above is from the Indeed job-board scraper (scrape_jobs_cron.py): it lists [MATCH] lines while scanning, then "Total newly found jobs", "Inserted into database" and one block per newly inserted job with title, company, experience, location, salary and link. Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

For each newly inserted job, apply the fake-job filter and drop any that: ask for money or documents upfront, have no identifiable company, promise unrealistic pay for the role and location, use "work from home opportunity / earn daily / no experience needed" phrasing, or have a suspicious shortened link.

Output:
🧭 New jobs (Indeed): one line per kept job as "<title> @ <company> (<experience>, <location>)" followed by the link on the next line.
Then one line: "Filtered out: N (<one-phrase reason each>)" if any were dropped.
Naukri is not scraped by this script (Cloudflare blocks it); do not mention Naukri.

If "Inserted into database: 0": respond with exactly [SILENT].
